variants.headline: Looking back: colony openly defies its charter
variants.sub: Open defiance of the charter is taking place in {colony}.
variants.body:
We return to {first_reported}. Our report recorded this: The colony was openly defying its charter.

The gazette records the defiance without assuming an amendment to the charter. Acting against a framework and changing that framework are distinct matters. A precise account should also separate the colony's position from any subsequent action by the home world, which this report does not establish as having occurred.

The event remains part of the record. Whether subsequent developments met the standard it raised is a separate question, not something the old headline can answer by itself.

We judge {target} adversely. Defiance demands a serious account of responsibility, and a bold stance should not be allowed to shelter inadequate political judgment behind the attraction of its own gesture.
